text:
mira: Vendor requests Thursday 08:00-14:00 UTC window for external pentest. Need to confirm RBAC scope, KMS decrypt access, and evidence handoff.
dan: I can scope ephemeral roles. What exact permissions?
mira: Minimal: cloudtrail-read, kube-audit-read, svcacct-list. No long-lived impersonation.
jules: Ops: we'll mint Vault->STS creds with 6h TTL. Need an AWS IAM condition to limit decrypt to assessor role and timebound.
dan: For KMS, propose a key policy allowing kms:Decrypt for assessor ARN with DateLessThan condition matching end time. I'll draft.
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-110 for access + artifacts.
mira: Evidence upload: ops to put sanitized logs into presigned S3 prefix (read-only) + manifest with sha256sums. Retain raw logs internal for 90 days.
jules: We'll run redaction pipeline before upload (emails, user_ids). Sample sed + jq step approved.
dan: Rollback plan: remove role binding at T+10m, revoke active STS tokens, verify canary deny test. I'll run a dry-run today.
security-bot: Reminder: run pre-window vuln whitelist scan (SEC-WHITELIST-v3).
mira: Confirmed: no PII in exported artifacts. If anything changes vendor must sign NDA addendum.
ops-bot: Oncall notified for window.
dan: Action items: I'll post RBAC PR and KMS snippet; jules will provision presigned bucket and lifecycle; mira will update ticket with retest dates.
mira: Thanks team. If rollback fails, page eng-oncall and tag me. :white_check_mark:
